residual.name: NON_RESOLVER_CONSTRUCTION_PATH
residual.statement: CandidateClassApplicabilityReceipt is a public frozen dataclass whose canonical_replay_only_order defaults to () and is never re-derived or validated in __post_init__. A hand-built receipt can therefore carry any order, or none, while replay_identity() is unchanged.
why_it_is_not_an_owner_contract_defect: the field is declared REPLAY_ONLY with zero ranking/priority/preference/weight/fallback semantics by the owner's own law
the order is a pure function of receipt.decisions, which the owner already includes in its identity material, so admitting it to _material() would be redundant
the only production producer of this receipt is the resolver, which always assigns the derived order

the selected ingress does not re-derive and does not trust the field: it binds the value it received into origin_receipt_hash, so any non-derived value is at worst a distinguishable origin, never a silent one
the accepted G2 binder and bound-F8 evaluator never read the field
